thread:
opsbot: INCIDENT: Elevated 5xx rate observed on inference-gateway-prod -> customers complaining about timeouts + 502s. Auto-pager to @Riley and #incidents.

Riley (oncall-sre): seeing it on dashboards, N% 5xx spike started ~10:25 UTC. Logs show upstream 502s from lb-pools. Paging in.

Carla (eng-runtime): any deploys to gateway or route config in last 30m?

Jun (infra): I didn't push anything. Cloud LB healthchecks + Envoy config change CI ran at 09:58 but flagged as succeeded.

Alex (prod-sre): customers with long requests (inference streams) are hit hardest, also small requests get intermittent 502. Could be retries + circuit-breaker interplay.

Tyler (eng-platform): I can roll traffic off the new route weights. Which route is hot?

Riley (oncall-sre): Querying envoy admin now: `curl -s http://localhost:19000/clusters | grep inference` shows a bunch of upstream 5xx and upstream_rq_5xx increases.

Carla (eng-runtime): Pulling the route config: `GET /config_dump` -> I see a recent rollout that added weighted clusters for canary. weights: primary=80, canary=20 but canary has tiny pool capacity.

Riley (oncall-sre): possible "snapback" where route weight moved to a less-capacity cluster -> upstream overload -> envoy retries amplify 5xx.

Jun (infra): I'm going to set the weighted route back to 100/0 and disable retries on that virtual host. Give me thumbs if OK.

Alex (prod-sre): +1. We should disable automatic retries (`retry_policy` -> none) before shifting weights to avoid retry amplification.

Tyler (eng-platform): Doing a quick config patch:
```
# disable retries on problem vhost
envoy.routes["/inference"].retry_policy: none
```
Applying now.

Carla (eng-runtime): Confirming canary pool shows high `cx_overflow` and `upstream_rq_5xx`. Looks like circuit-breaker hard limit kicked in and then clients hit fallback path returning 502.

Riley (oncall-sre): After disabling retries, I'm going to slowly shift weights 90/10 -> 100/0. Patching via control plane.

opsbot: deploy-bot: Change 7f2a3 applied to route weights (90/10 -> 100/0) by Jun.

Jun (infra): weight now 100/0. Watch metrics.

Riley (oncall-sre): 5xx rate halved in 30s. Latency back to normal for many customers. Still seeing some residual 502s from older connections.

Carla (eng-runtime): I'm also bumping circuit-breaker thresholds temporarily: `max_connections` +20% on primary pool and increasing `max_pending_requests` to avoid immediate ejects while we validate.

Alex (prod-sre): Good. Can we add an emergency alert to pause any automated rollout jobs for the gateway until postmortem?

Tyler (eng-platform): Added a temporary admission block on gateway route rollouts. I also turned on more verbose tracing for the lb path to capture exact failure modes.

Riley (oncall-sre): Customer impact: spike affected ~3% of requests, primarily in us-west. No data loss; requests returned 502/timeouts. Paging contact list: some enterprise customers (customer-A) opened support tickets.

Carla (eng-runtime): Root cause hypothesis: new canary weight routed traffic to underprovisioned pool -> cb thresholds hit -> Envoy reties + upstream 502 -> cascade. Config change in CI didn't catch low pool size in canary.

Jun (infra): Mitigation summary: rolled weights back, disabled retries on vhost, increased cb thresholds, blocked rollouts. 5xx rates trending down.

Riley (oncall-sre): Going to keep oncall for 40m to watch for flare ups. Will follow up with an RCA ticket.

opsbot: incident-bot: Severity: SEV2. Start time: 1719009999. Affected regions: us-west.

Alex (prod-sre): Action items (short):
- eng-runtime: add pre-rollout pool-health check + capacity gate
- infra: add canary capacity estimator to rollout CI
- eng-platform: add automatic rollback if upstream_rq_5xx > threshold within 5m
- oncall: notify affected customers + post initial incident summary

Carla (eng-runtime): I'll open the PR for the capacity gate today and link to incident ticket.

Jun (infra): I'll add a CI job to simulate low-pool health during canary.

Tyler (eng-platform): I'll draft rollback policy and auto-rollback guard.

Riley (oncall-sre): Notifying support for customer outreach. Thanks everyone for fast responses. Will keep thread updated. :thumbsup:

opsbot: incident-bot: Marking follow-up tasks and assigning. Next update due in 30m.
